nodes.source_location: How was it tested? and Checklist

nodes.label: Local-First Architecture
nodes.rationale: Keeps chats, memories, vectors, and provider credentials under the user's control by default.

nodes.label: Zero-Maintenance Model Discovery
nodes.rationale: Live model discovery avoids configuration edits when models, providers, or hardware change.

nodes.label: In-Memory API Key Vault
nodes.rationale: Session-only storage prevents UI-entered provider keys from being written to disk, logs, or exports.

nodes.label: Background Generation Jobs
nodes.rationale: Off-thread generation keeps Streamlit responsive and allows generation to survive page navigation.

nodes.label: No Built-In Authentication
nodes.rationale: The application is intended for localhost or trusted-network use rather than direct exposure to untrusted networks.

nodes.label: Session-Only API Keys
nodes.rationale: API keys are held in process memory, never written to disk or logs, and sent only to their owning provider.

nodes.label: Localhost Trust Boundary
nodes.rationale: The lack of authentication makes untrusted network exposure unsafe.

nodes.label: Private Vulnerability Reporting
nodes.rationale: Potential key leaks, unintended prompt disclosure, and unsafe parsing should be disclosed privately instead of through public issues.

nodes.label: Background Worker Pattern
nodes.rationale: Daemon-thread jobs decouple long-running inference from Streamlit reruns and keep the user interface responsive.

nodes.label: Progressive Codebase Study Plan
nodes.rationale: The reading order progresses from product goals and persistence through runtime orchestration, retrieval, providers, pages, and preprocessing.
